The day before every Sunday long run is either full rest or the B2B medium-long, never a quality session. No table tennis this cycle (athlete 9/30). || METHOD - UPHILL ATHLETE (Johnston/House). Base = high-volume, low-intensity aerobic work below AeT, progressed by hours (~10%/wk, recovery week every 3rd-4th week), with strength and alactic hill sprints alongside; intensity above AeT is added only when there is no aerobic deficiency. THE AeT GATE: heart-rate drift test (uphillathlete.com/aerobic-training/heart-rate-drift): treadmill at 3%, chest strap, 15-min warm-up to a stable starting HR, 60 min at one locked speed, drift = avg HR 2nd half / avg HR 1st half - 1. 3.5-5.0% -> AeT = starting HR; <3.5% -> retest +5 bpm; >5% -> retest -5 bpm. THE 10% RULE: AeT within 10% of LTHR (168) means no aerobic-deficiency syndrome (ADS). 168 x 0.90 = 151.2, so PASS = AeT >= 152 bpm. PASS -> every aet_gate slot promotes its if_pass version (Z3 uphill intervals; the seasonal 4x4 in W14-15). FAIL/UNTESTED -> Z1-2 only, the default versions run, retest every 4-6 weeks (10/13, 11/24, 1/5, 2/16). A later fail after a pass demotes the slots again. Why a treadmill: constant pace is what the drift arithmetic assumes, and the Nov/Jan retests need the same setup in winter. || ZONES - UA MODEL ANCHORED ON AeT (replaces the Friel-table caps for this cycle): Z1 (recovery) = up to AeT-10% | Z2 (aerobic) = AeT-10% .. AeT | Z3 = AeT .. LT | Z4 = around LT. The schema's hr_zone labels are kept for the app (Friel bands at LTHR 168: Z1 <142, Z2 142-150, Z3 151-158, Z4 159-167) and hr_anchor states what the cap is tied to. PROVISIONAL AeT = 149 (the old Friel Z2 top) until 10/13; every AeT-anchored hr_cap_bpm (AeT 149, AeT-10% 134) is re-computed by an anchored patch revision after each valid test. || NEW FIELDS (schema 1.6, additive; master_schema_v5.json): run session hr_anchor (enum: AeT | AeT_minus_10pct | AeT_to_LT | AeT_test | none) - the reference the cap is computed from; run session aet_gate (object: slot, active_version default|if_pass, default_rationale, pass_rule, if_pass{subtype,title,hr_zone,hr_cap_bpm,hr_anchor,key_cue}) - the conditional version of a gated session; load fields are identical in both versions, so a promotion never changes a weekly sum. sessions.title: AeT HEART-RATE DRIFT TEST #1 (treadmill, 3%)
sessions.key_cue: Uphill Athlete protocol. SETUP: treadmill at 3% (same machine and grade every test), CHEST STRAP (wet the contacts), fan on, cool room, same time of day and same pre-test meal as test #1, no caffeine in the 3 h before, after a rest day. WARM-UP 15 min: walk, then build speed until HR sits stable for 2-3 min at the STARTING HR. STARTING HR: test #1 = 145 bpm (between your race-validated ~136-150 band and the 149 working cap). Retests start at the last measured AeT. LAP. TEST 60 min at ONE locked speed and grade - do not touch the controls. LAP at 30:00 and at 60:00. COOL-DOWN 10 min easy. RESULT = avg HR 2nd half / avg HR 1st half - 1. <3.5% = your AeT is higher: retest +5 bpm. 3.5-5.0% = AeT = your starting HR. >5% = started above AeT: retest -5 bpm. GATE: AeT >= 152 (within 10% of LTHR 168) -> no aerobic deficiency; Z3 sessions switch on. Below 152 -> Z1-2 only, retest in 4-6 weeks. FIT to the Drive inbox the same day.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Test. The hr_cap_bpm here is only the provisional alert; the starting HR in the cue governs. sessions.title: AeT HEART-RATE DRIFT TEST #2 (treadmill, 3%)
sessions.key_cue: Uphill Athlete protocol. SETUP: treadmill at 3% (same machine and grade every test), CHEST STRAP (wet the contacts), fan on, cool room, same time of day and same pre-test meal as test #1, no caffeine in the 3 h before, after a rest day. WARM-UP 15 min: walk, then build speed until HR sits stable for 2-3 min at the STARTING HR. STARTING HR: test #1 = 145 bpm (between your race-validated ~136-150 band and the 149 working cap). Retests start at the last measured AeT. LAP. TEST 60 min at ONE locked speed and grade - do not touch the controls. LAP at 30:00 and at 60:00. COOL-DOWN 10 min easy.
